title: The Lion and the Drum
subtitle: A legend about courage and cleverness
moral: A calm mind can outsmart a fearsome threat.
body: A great lion once terrorized a village, frightening the herders and keeping families awake through the night. None dared face the beast directly, for his roar alone could shake the ground.
A young herder, known more for his quick thinking than his strength, devised a plan. He hollowed out a large drum and hid within a nearby thicket, waiting for the lion's approach.

When the lion neared, the herder struck the drum with a thunderous rhythm unlike anything the lion had heard before. Startled and confused, the lion fled deep into the hills, never to trouble the village again.
The village celebrated not the herder's muscles, but his ingenuity — a reminder that courage often wears the face of a clear and steady mind.
